headline: Marcopolo shares drop 3.64% following weak third-quarter earnings
summary: Marcopolo reported weak third-quarter 2026 results with falling sales and profitability pressure, prompting negative analyst revisions and sending shares down 3.64% to R$ 3.44.
why: Marcopolo is a major bus manufacturer whose quarterly earnings reflect industrial demand and cost pressures.

impacts.name: Marcopolo
impacts.why: Weak third-quarter financial results led to a 3.64% drop in the company's stock price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Disappointing third-quarter sales and compressed profit margins led to a negative market reaction and a drop in share prices.
